title: Red Paw Vision
description: A large red cracked paw print dominates the composition, containing a surreal black and white scene of stylized faces with multiple eyes, a backpack-wearing child figure, and geometric patterns. Smaller crystal balls with cosmic interiors appear in the corners alongside a white animal paw print and a small standing child with a backpack on the bottom right.
prompt: Surreal symbolic illustration featuring a giant cracked red paw print as the central frame on a white background. Inside the paw's negative space is an intricate black and white scene showing multiple stylized faces with many eyes, a small child figure with a backpack, and abstract patterns. Smaller detailed crystal balls with galaxy and cosmic designs float in the corners. A white animal paw print appears in the upper right. A small full-body child character with a backpack stands at the bottom right. High contrast, mystical atmosphere, detailed linework.
